messages:
nora: FYI I'm breaking the single usage-tiers doc into two pages: /metering and /pricing to make examples clearer. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 — need review on SDK snippets, example payload schemas, and dashboard links.
ash: Can you paste the snippet link?
nora: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901/files#diff-xyz
diego: Quick pass: Python example still shows `client.create_usage` (old). Should be `client.report_usage(payload)`. Also, avoid embedding internal grafana panel ids in the public guide.
rae: Agreed. Replace panel ids with `{{public_dashboard_link}}` tokens and put an internal mapping table in a private ops doc. That prevents future link rot.
nora: Good idea, adding tokens + ops mapping pointer.
nash: For migration content: add a tiny JSON schema example and call out the field rename from `token_count` -> `token_total`. Some customers depend on the older key, so include a compatibility snippet showing both keys and a transform.
diego: Also be explicit about rate limit behavior: show a 429 example JSON with `quota_reason` and `retry_after`. Small client backoff snippet would help people.
rae: I can paste a compact backoff example for docs-tests:
```
# docs-tests friendly backoff
for attempt in range(4):
    r = client.report_usage(payload)
    if r.status_code == 429:
        sleep(int(r.headers.get('Retry-After', '1')) * (2 ** attempt))
    else:
        break
```
i18n-bot: Reminder: mark user-facing strings with `_()` for extraction. The previous merge missed a couple of sentences.
nora: Will mark them and bump the extraction.
docs-ci: lint check queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/901. Note: one trailing space reported in a fenced code block.
nora: Fixed. Pushed.
docs-ci: staging preview ready: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/metering (deprecated examples show banner; tokens render as links to friendly dashboards).
nora: Tests passing, merging after one more approval. Thanks folks.
nash: I'll follow up with a short note in the release changelog about the split and the payload rename.
nora: Added changelog entry. Merged. Closing thread.
